## Review checklist (optional)
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests` passes
- [ ] `npx oxlint` passes in `frontend/`
- [ ] Tried it in the app (`npm run dev`) with the sample files in `data/`
- [ ] Technical docs updated (`documentation/local-setup.md`, sub-READMEs); main README only for a major change
- [ ] No large files committed (checkpoints, `data/raw/`, `.env.local`)
- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `chore/*`
